title: Attention-weighted head-matched KV bridge versus fixed support and shared basis
hypothesis: For the frozen Pythia-70M→SmolLM2-135M pair, choosing a one-to-one source KV-head assignment by target attention-weighted calibration loss improves fresh target NLL over the fixed spread assignment. A rank-32 shared map basis over the chosen head bridges retains matched-independent-map quality within 0.05 nat while reducing actual serialized bridge bytes by at least 50%.
physical_object: Per-layer source-to-target KV affine translator maps across 180 target layer/head/role slots.
mirror_coordinate: Per-target-layer head-address assignment plus per-role coefficient vector into a shared PCA map basis.
logical_multiplicity: Distinct target KV roles read from a compactly addressed set of source-head supports.
prior_art_boundary: PA237 CacheBridge motivates matched-head support and causal-attention-weighted calibration. This is a scoped local operationalization, not a paper reproduction.

models.source: EleutherAI/pythia-70m-deduped (8 KV heads, GPTNeoX RoPE fraction .25, theta 10000)
models.target: HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-135M (3 KV heads, Llama RoPE theta 100000)

controls: Fixed spread source-head mapping [0,4,7] with attention-weighted affine ridge
Calibration-selected injective source-head mapping with attention-weighted affine ridge (CacheBridge-style support control)
Same attention-matched map family coded by a rank-32 shared PCA basis (native shared-basis attribution control)
matching_rule: For each target layer and target KV head, accumulate candidate weighted ridge sufficient statistics over source KV heads. Per-token importance is target attention mass received, summed over queries and query heads in the KV group, normalized to mean one per prompt. Select the injective 3-of-8 assignment minimizing the sum of normalized weighted K/V fit residuals. Fit selected affine maps with alpha 0.01.
depth_rule: Map target layers to nearest relative source depth using round(tgt_layer*(source_layers-1)/(target_layers-1)).
roPE_control: Both head-support controls use the same position-free interface: invert source and target RoPE for keys during mapping, fit values without RoPE, then reapply target RoPE. MA-877 established this comparison lane; MA-878 varies head support only.

development.selection_metric: Minimum target NLL among rank candidates, while reporting its gap to matched-independent maps and the exact serialized-byte frontier.

fresh.prompt_identity: exact tokenizer offset alignment; deterministic seed-disjoint prompt chunks

paid_objects: fixed or matched affine maps OR shared mean and rank basis and per-role coefficients
storage.common_model_weights: reported separately; excluded from marginal translator comparison

compute.gpu_latency: CUDA unavailable; no GPU runtime claim

success_gate: For every fresh seed, attention-matched full maps improve next-token NLL over fixed-spread full maps by at least 0.10 nat; rank32 shared maps are within +0.05 nat of matched full maps; rank32 NLL is within +0.50 nat of native target; actual shared serialized payload is at most 50% of matched full-map payload.
failure_gate: Any required quality or storage gate fails in at least two of three fresh seeds, or actual prompt identities / target-attention weighting / serialization checks fail.
boundaries: One next-token probe per test prompt; no generation-trajectory claim.
Only three fresh seed partitions and one natural-language corpus.
PCA is the native non-Mirror shared-basis control; equal outputs at equal bytes are not Mirror-specific.
CPU latency only; no CacheBridge paper reproduction or GPU-serving claim.
